escapeJson.description: 转义 JSON 字符串中的特殊字符。将 JSON 数据转换为正确的转义格式，以便安全传输或存储。
escapeJson.shortDescription: 转义 JSON 中的特殊字符
escapeJson.title: 转义 JSON
escapeJson.resultTitle: 转义后的 JSON 字符串
escapeJson.longDescription: JSON escaping converts special characters inside JSON data into escaped sequences that can be safely stored, transmitted, or embedded inside another JSON document or programming language string. This tool escapes characters such as double quotes, backslashes, and line breaks while preserving the original data structure. Use it when you need to transform JSON into a string-safe representation for APIs, configuration files, databases, or source code.
escapeJson.wrapOutputDescription: Add double quotes around the escaped JSON output to create a JSON string.

jsonToXml.shortDescription: 将 JSON 转换为 XML 格式
jsonToXml.title: JSON 到 XML

options.addMetaTagDesc: Add a meta tag at the beginning of the XML output
options.useSpaceDesc: Use spaces to visualize the hierarchical structure of XML.
options.useTabDesc: Use tabs to visualize the hierarchical structure of XML.

minify.description: 从 JSON 中删除所有不必要的空格。
minify.shortDescription: 通过删除空格来缩小 JSON
minify.title: 最小化 JSON

toolInfo.description: JSON 压缩是指在保持 JSON 数据有效性的同时，从中移除所有不必要的空格字符的过程。这包括移除 JSON 正确解析所需的空格、换行符和缩进。压缩可以减小 JSON 数据的大小，使其在保持完全相同的数据结构和值的同时，更高效地存储和传输。
toolInfo.title: 什么是 JSON 最小化？

prettify.description: 使用适当的缩进和间距来格式化 JSON。
prettify.shortDescription: 格式化并美化 JSON 代码
prettify.title: 美化 JSON

toolInfo.description: 此工具允许您使用适当的缩进和间距格式化 JSON 数据，使其更具可读性且更易于使用。
toolInfo.title: 美化 JSON

stringify.description: 将 JavaScript 对象转换为 JSON 字符串格式。将数据结构序列化为 JSON 字符串以便存储或传输。
stringify.shortDescription: 将对象转换为 JSON 字符串
stringify.title: 字符串化 JSON

options.escapeHtmlDesc: Convert HTML special characters to their entity references

toolInfo.description: JSON Stringify is a tool that converts JavaScript objects and arrays into their JSON string representation. It properly formats the output with customizable indentation and offers the option to escape HTML special characters, making it safe for web usage. This tool is particularly useful when you need to serialize data structures for storage or transmission, or when you need to prepare JSON data for HTML embedding.
toolInfo.title: What Is JSON Stringify ?

validateJson.description: 检查 JSON 是否有效且格式正确。
validateJson.shortDescription: 验证 JSON 代码是否存在错误
validateJson.title: 验证 JSON

toolInfo.description: JSON（JavaScript 对象表示法）是一种轻量级数据交换格式。JSON 验证可确保数据结构符合 JSON 标准。有效的 JSON 对象必须具备以下特征：- 属性名称用双引号括起来。- 正确匹配的花括号 {}。- 最后一个键值对后没有尾随逗号。- 对象和数组的嵌套正确。此工具会检查输入的 JSON 并提供反馈，以帮助识别和修复常见错误。
toolInfo.title: 什么是 JSON 验证？

jsonToCsv.description: 把 JSON 数据转换成 CSV，支持嵌套对象和数组，可直接用 Excel 打开。
jsonToCsv.title: JSON 转 CSV

alwaysQuote.description: Wrap every cell in double-quotes, regardless of its content.
alwaysQuote.label: Always quote

autoQuote.description: Only quote cells that contain the delimiter, a double-quote, or a newline. Keeps output clean and minimal.
autoQuote.label: Auto (recommended)

options.delimiter: Character used to separate values in each row (e.g. comma, semicolon, tab)

header.description: Use JSON keys as column names in the first row. Recommended for readability and import compatibility.
header.label: Include header row

sortJson.description: 按指定字段给 JSON 对象数组排序，或按字母顺序排列对象的键。
sortJson.title: JSON 排序
sortJson.longDescription: This tool allows you to easily sort JSON data in a structured and predictable way. You can sort an array of objects by any key, choosing either ascending or descending order, which is useful for organizing data such as lists of users, products, or records. Alternatively, you can sort the keys of a JSON object alphabetically to improve readability and consistency. The tool supports flexible sorting modes and handles common JSON structures, making it ideal for developers, data analysts, and anyone working with JSON data who needs clean, ordered output.

options.keyDescription: Select the key to sort by
options.modeDescription: Choose whether to sort array items by a key's value, or sort the keys of an object alphabetically
options.title: Sorting Options
